snippet.title: Puppy Truck - Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
🐕 Puppy Truck's demo is LIVE NOW on Steam! 🛻

Puppy Truck is a puzzle-packed 3D platforming adventure about a tiny truck with the heart of a puppy! Explore Grandma’s eclectic house, filled with contraptions, challenges, and surprises as you race to make it to the birthday party on time. 

🐕 Play the demo now: https://midnighte.rs/puppytruck-steam

This trailer was a part of ✨Midnight Screening 2026✨ a showcase of new games, demo drops and trailers! Check out the full lineup here: https://youtu.be/FFpPlTp4eyo

See the full Midnighters lineup on our website: http://www.midnighters.games
